lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region. Arrangement consists of roughly seven visible vertical columns of spots, with larger centroids located along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity aligned with the spot centroids, forming a distinct grid-like architecture most prominent in the central lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper-mid flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the superior aspect and darker shadowing immediately inferior.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small yellow teleost near the anterior insertion of the pectoral fin and multiple remoras attached ventrally.
